messages:
Ava (CEO): Leadership snapshot for the week — three quick asks: reliability triage, Private pilot readiness, and a short cost play. Please reply with a one-line owner commit.

Ava (CEO): Reliability: aim for user errors <=1% and p99 within 20% of baseline for core routes for the next 7 days. Treat as high priority.

Liam (Head of Reliability): Quick metric snippet (24h): p99 228ms, user-errors 1.4%, cache-hit 13%. Notable: bursty tail at 03:00 UTC.

Maya (VP Eng): Found a memory churn pattern in kv-cache; will run a focused canary and hold non-essential pushes.

Diego (VP Product): Private pilot: legal cleared NDA; need audit-log defaults and onboarding checklist. I'll own the checklist.

Sam (Head of Finance): Cost: modeling a 10% unit-cost plan; short levers are batching and embedding cache. Will share runway impact by Fri.

OpsBot: Canary initiated: hosted-canary -> 3 nodes, build 2026.07.12-rc1. Monitoring hooks live.

Ava (CEO): Please post your one-line commitments below (EOD). Ill join the readiness call if timings align. :eyes:

Maya (VP Eng): Commitment: Run kv-cache canary, pause non-critical pushes, post results by Wed 15:00 UTC.

Liam (Head of Reliability): Commitment: Add 5% reserved capacity to critical routes and update runbook within 3h.

Diego (VP Product): Commitment: Publish pilot onboarding checklist and support stub by EOD tomorrow.

Sam (Head of Finance): Commitment: Deliver cost scenario slides (5/10/15%) by Friday EOD.
